reuse.why: Builds on the tree's shouldFillCategory, getFillCategories, getAverageFillCategories and spendingToBudgetAmount for every rule and the new action, but matches the #fixed tag with its own regex instead of the shared tag parsing in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: Rule logic is defined once; only the new notes join and goal_def column are added to both getBudgetData and getFillCategories SQL.

placement.why: New exclusions live inside shouldFillCategory in budget/actions.ts and the method is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings.

scope.why: Only the requested rules, the new action, the flag, a test and release notes; the swapped option order in shouldFillCategory is cosmetic.

maintainability.why: A single predicate with named helpers (isFixedGroup, hasSavedTemplates) carries all exclusions and the flag is threaded cleanly; the bespoke tag regex may drift from how tags are parsed elsewhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including setLastMonthSpending, goes through shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repetition is the notes join/goal_def column in the two loader queries, added openly.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory gains generic rule terms (fixed group, saved templates) and reuses its existing includeHidden option; only getAverageFillCategories gains an includeHidden parameter to thread the flag.
